Prepare the update. Reply with {"messages": [...], "revised_schedule": [...], "volunteer_tasks": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill. Do NOT create files: Ripple builds the .ics and .csv itself.
- One message per affected group (effect "inform", "resize" or the disruption origin); "group" = the group id. Say only what changed for that group. status "draft".
- "to": the address of a single person (see the attached people.csv), otherwise a short description like "40 workshop participants".
- "actions": the recovery checklist for the organizer team, 3 to 8 items, most urgent first: {"title", "description", "owner" (a role or team named in the files, e.g. "Volunteer lead", "Organizer", "Caterer"), "deadline" (a time or day taken from the plan, never invented), "priority" ("high"|"medium"|"low")}. Include confirming every item of the chosen option's "to_confirm" list.
- "revised_schedule": every schedule item or commitment whose time or place changes: {"id": node id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM", "place": "..."}. Empty list if nothing moves.

messages.subject: Venue change for 21 November
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall we had booked for 21 November has been cancelled by the organiser's venue. The event is moving to Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre, 195 rue Saint-Jacques, Paris 5e (source: https://parisjetaime.com/eng/convention/article/your-event-academic-places-a1323).

What changes for you:
- Opening now starts at 09:00 at the new venue.
- Lunch is now at 12:00–13:00 at the new venue.
- Awards now run 16:30–17:00.

We will confirm the final venue details and any remaining timings shortly. Thank you for your understanding.

messages.subject: Venue change: your opening keynote
messages.body:
Hello,

Due to a venue cancellation, the event moves to Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre, 195 rue Saint-Jacques, Paris 5e. Your opening keynote at 09:00 stays at the same time, now in the new venue.

We will confirm final details shortly.

messages.subject: Venue change: your workshop
messages.body:
Hello,

Due to a venue cancellation, the event moves to Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre, 195 rue Saint-Jacques, Paris 5e. Your workshop stays at 10:00–11:00. We are checking whether a separate room B exists or whether the workshop will run in the amphitheatre, and will confirm shortly.

messages.subject: Venue change: awards hosting
messages.body:
Hello,

Due to a venue cancellation, the event moves to Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre, 195 rue Saint-Jacques, Paris 5e. The awards slot is now 16:30–17:00 at the new venue.

We will confirm final details shortly.

messages.subject: Meet-up time and place changed
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall has been cancelled. The volunteer meet-up moves to 07:15 at Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre, 195 rue Saint-Jacques, Paris 5e (previously 07:45 at the main hall). Please arrive on time.

messages.subject: Workshop location update
messages.body:
Hello,

The main hall has been cancelled. The workshop by Speaker 2 at 10:00–11:00 moves to Maison de l'Océan – Grand Amphithéâtre, 195 rue Saint-Jacques, Paris 5e. The exact room is being confirmed and we will tell you shortly.

The user asked for no file creation, and the custom instruction says files are built by Ripple, so I'll omit the `files` key. Let me note the key points before composing.

Notes:
- Affected groups: attendees (200), speakers (3 individual + group), volunteers (12), workshop participants (40), caterer.
- Speaker 3 and volunteers' meet-up at 07:45 in the main hall change to 07:15 at the new venue, per the chosen scenario's `volunteer_meetup` change.
- The to_confirm list has 8 items, which I must all include in actions (max 8 total, so I'll fold them carefully).
- Deadlines must come from the plan; I'll use times in the source (e.g. 2026-11-21 event date, 07:15 meet-up, 07:30 AV setup).
- Attendees' address "[FICTIONAL ADDRESS]" for the old hall should not be invented; the new address (195 rue Saint-Jacques) comes from the scenario with its source URL.
- Revised schedule: items whose time or place changes.

Contract note: the skill's `actions` field isn't in the reference shape, but the user explicitly requested it, so I'll include it in each message's structure at the top level as the user specified.

I'm also keeping the group messages to "what changed". Individual speaker messages use the people.csv emails; volunteer lead gets a message as a group member, and the attendee/caterer/workshop groups use short descriptions.
